# HarborIQ

> HarborIQ answers an independent insurance agency's carrier questions from the agency's own carrier guides, with the page cited, and keeps the book, renewals, tasks and inbox in one client record beside the AMS the agency already has. Two ways to start: a **free agency workspace** ($0 per agency) and **Intelligence** at $29 per agency per month, or $290 per year, for agencies up to 30 people. Never priced per person. Canonical domain: https://harboriq.co

Key facts (as of November 2026):
- Intelligence, $29 per agency per month or $290 per year billed upfront, covers every person at the agency up to 30 people; larger agencies ask for a quote. 300 carrier checks each month shared across the agency; one carrier check is one carrier question and its source-backed answer. Optional $10 packs add 100 checks, only when the agency chooses. No automatic top-ups.
- Intelligence includes the agency record: clients, policies, renewals built from expiration dates with an owner and days out, tasks and notes on the client record, and Gmail connected to it. Outlook is coming soon.
- Free agency workspace, $0 per agency: the same record, private underwriter contacts and portal links, license and CE reminders, and a limited number of carrier checks with sources.
- HarborIQ works beside the AMS, not instead of it. Agencies export the book from Applied Epic, EZLynx, HawkSoft, NowCerts or AMS360 as CSV or XLSX; HarborIQ maps the columns and keeps a working copy. There is no live AMS sync today. The AMS keeps carrier downloads and accounting.
- HarborIQ replaces the generic CRM (GoHighLevel, AgencyZoom), the renewal spreadsheet, sticky notes and memory. It does not replace the AMS or the carriers.
- Carrier knowledge comes from the guides the agency loads: any carrier, any state, any line of business. Answers are only ever drawn from those documents, with the page cited. Agency data is never used to train AI models.
- Agency OS, the whole agency on one record (book, pipeline, renewals, commissions, reports, team), is sold by walkthrough only and priced by agency size, never per person. Ask on a demo.
- Month to month, cancel anytime, full export any time. Built by an agency operator.
